reaction: Quickstart page: configure chain ID, state sync and public explorer, then connect MetaMask and send transactions; next steps list (send / simulate transactions, deploy contracts, API)

reaction: Diagram: State Sync OFF (fork frozen at the fork block) vs ON (fork keeps pulling parent-chain state); section "Which parent-network state does latest reflect?"

reaction: Cheatcode list: evm_increaseTime, evm_setNextBlockTimestamp, evm_increaseBlocks (time travel), tenderly_setBalance / setErc20Balance, evm_snapshot / evm_revert; each call appears in the activity table as a TenderlyCheatcodes transaction (setErc20Balance, addBalance, syncState)

reaction: Diagram of a fork branching off mainnet with evm_snapshot then evm_revert rolling back; "Revert distance limit": one evm_revert can roll back at most 2000 blocks
pattern: Snapshot/restore as first-class sandbox controls

reaction: Virtual Environment Activity view: executed transactions with network, status, function, block, hash, from, to; sidebar Contracts, Wallets, JSON-RPC Calls

reaction: "Simulate Transactions in Virtual Environments": preview outcome, gas, state changes and emitted events before sending; entry cards Simulator UI, Simulation RPC, Bundle Simulation RPC, Simulation API
